create.statement: Rust consumers use in-process Rust APIs, not a CLI subprocess, for requirements-as-code authoring and SDK operations.
create.description: The existing provenance-core crate supplies pure authoring semantics. Provenance-store remains the sole stateful engine. A thin provenance-sdk facade supplies Rust ergonomics. Direct use of provenance-core plus provenance-store remains supported.

create.title: Keep Rust authoring semantics in provenance-core
create.position: Place pure builders, document-decidable structural checks, address construction, canonical authored assembly, and the TypedSpec input family in the existing provenance-core crate.
create.rationale: A new engine crate or SDK-owned materializer would duplicate ownership. Provenance-core already owns protocol and domain types, stays dependency-light, and is shared by store and wire consumers.

create.title: Keep the stateful Rust seam in provenance-store
create.position: Keep identity, reconciliation, ownership refusal, STE write gates, locking, planning, and mutation in provenance-store, and expose its SDK operations as in-process functions.
create.rationale: The store already owns persistent state and one plan/apply path. A separate provenance-engine crate or CLI library seam would add another owner or lose store behavior.

create.title: Preserve typed-spec wire semantics
create.position: Route wire ingestion through the kernel at the existing pipeline points without changing protocol 4, schema 1, acceptance, first-error order, error wording, or decoded response order.
create.rationale: Existing TypeScript documents and other wire consumers must keep the same engine contract while semantic code moves to its shared home.

create.title: Use a thin provenance-sdk facade
create.position: Add provenance-sdk as re-exports plus verification orchestration, macro projections, settings, a parity ledger, and engine_info().
create.rationale: These are Rust frontend concerns that do not belong in the pure core. Keeping materialization, validation, identity, planning, and mutation outside the facade prevents a second semantic layer.

create.title: Use Cargo compatibility for the Rust SDK
create.position: Use Cargo semver for in-process compatibility and Cargo path or patch configuration for explicit development overrides.
create.rationale: An in-process Rust consumer resolves crates through Cargo and does not need a duplicate runtime protocol handshake. Wire consumers keep the existing protocol check.

create.title: Deliver synchronous Rust verification first
create.position: Ship synchronous Rust verification first, record callback failure before propagation, and defer asynchronous verification.
create.rationale: The synchronous API matches current engine operations and TypeScript failure semantics. Async support can follow without delaying the first native Rust surface.

create.title: Resolve Rust implementation symbols in provenance-store
create.position: Resolve implementation symbols to repository files in provenance-store and reject missing or ambiguous matches before apply writes state.
create.rationale: The scanner supplies evidence, but the stateful apply boundary must own the decision and its no-write refusal behavior.

create.title: Audit Rust crates before publication
create.position: Do not publish the Rust crates until the DR10 audit covers public APIs, dependency closure, version coupling, engine identity, and MSRV, and Ben records a separate go decision.
create.rationale: Publishing too early can freeze accidental APIs or an incomplete dependency chain. Graph promotion is not crate publication.

create.title: Accept rejection-precedence risk with a fixture
create.position: Accept rejection-precedence risk only if a multi-defect fixture pins the current per-item first error.
create.rationale: Static call placement alone does not prove intra-list precedence. CO-R7-3 makes the stronger commitment observable.

create.title: Accept error-wording risk with pre-capture
create.position: Accept relocation-time error-wording risk only if current wire wording is captured before the kernel takes ownership.
create.rationale: CO-R7-4 and CO-R7-5 separate engine-identical wire text from TypeScript-parity build-time text.

create.title: Accept discovery-fallback risk with a fixture
create.position: Accept the no-repository discovery risk with a fixture for the canonicalized start-directory fallback.
create.rationale: CO-R7-7 closes the current test gap without changing discovery semantics.

create.title: Accept the static empty-statement finding
create.position: Accept the static empty-statement finding if V2 verifies the wire and STE rejection paths during execution.
create.rationale: Independent code reading found no engine wire rejection, but execution is the final check.

create.title: Accept temporary TypeScript mirror risk
create.position: Accept temporary TypeScript mirror drift while the kernel is authoritative and the cross-SDK corpus monitors parity.
create.rationale: Deleting TypeScript mirrors is a separate change. V3 detects drift during the redundancy period.

create.title: Accept publication risk behind the audit gate
create.position: Accept publication-surface uncertainty only behind the DR10 audit and a later human go decision.
create.rationale: Engine version, dependency closure, MSRV, and public API exposure can change the release decision but cannot bypass G1.

create.title: Accept process-global host limits
create.position: Accept process-global current-directory, environment, and advisory-lock limits and document them for in-process hosts.
create.rationale: The first API keeps current engine behavior. Documentation makes the concurrency limit explicit.

create.title: Accept the heuristic purity check
create.position: Accept V12 as a compile-time import check plus deterministic property tests, not a formal proof of purity.
create.rationale: The checks catch the expected dependency and behavior violations without claiming a machine proof.

create.title: Accept stranded verification-run risk
create.position: Accept that aborts, process death, or direct engine use can leave a verification run marked running.
create.rationale: The facade records ordinary errors and unwinds before propagation. It cannot recover after process termination or bypass by direct consumers.

create.title: Treat goldens as change detectors
create.position: Accept golden files and corpus fixtures as change detectors rather than complete proofs.
create.rationale: The fixtures protect named behavior while property, conformance, and existing engine tests cover other dimensions.

create.title: Accept design-stage execution uncertainty
create.position: Accept that Design review executed no code if V1 through V12 and the two Plan-entry checks discharge the uncertainty before reliance.
create.rationale: The reviews establish ownership and controls from repository evidence. Tests and Plan-entry checks remain required before implementation claims success.

create.name: Pure Rust authoring kernel
create.description: The kernel can use pure core types and functions. It cannot read process or repository state.
create.statement: Rust authoring build and materialize operations perform no file, environment, process, clock, repository, scanner, or store access.

create.name: Canonical Rust authored documents
create.statement: The Rust authoring kernel orders sources and requirements by key and rules by serialized address with lexicographic UTF-8 byte order.

create.name: Trim Rust build-time text
create.statement: Rust build-time content checks reject text that is empty after trimming, matching TypeScript requireText behavior.

create.name: Stable typed-spec wire acceptance
create.statement: A protocol-4 typed-spec document receives the same accept-or-reject result after kernel extraction as it received before extraction.

create.name: Stable first wire error
create.statement: For a typed-spec document with more than one defect, kernel extraction preserves the first engine error class and text.

create.name: Preserve decoded wire order
create.statement: Wire ingestion returns resources and diagnostics in decoded document order and does not apply authored-document canonical ordering.

create.name: Round-trip Rust typed input
create.statement: A Rust TypedSpec input round trip preserves every present field and the existing omission behavior.

create.name: Store-owned persistent identity
create.description: Id resolution includes local-to-shared migration, ownership checks, explicit-id validation, and resolution-dependent collision checks.
create.statement: Only provenance-store determines persistent declaration identity.

create.name: Semantics-free Rust facade
create.statement: The provenance-sdk facade delegates materialization, structural validation, address construction, identity, planning, and mutation to provenance-core or provenance-store.

create.name: Record Rust verification failure first
create.statement: When a Rust verification callback returns an error or unwinds, verification records the run as failed before it propagates the callback failure.

create.name: Refuse unresolved Rust symbols
create.statement: Rust SDK apply writes no state when an implementation symbol does not resolve to exactly one repository file.

create.name: Store-owned Rust symbol resolution
create.statement: Only provenance-store resolves an implementation symbol to a repository file for Rust SDK apply.

create.name: Audit before Rust crate publication
create.statement: Rust crate publication starts only after the DR10 audit is complete and Ben records a separate go decision.

create.name: Recheck Cargo artifact dependencies
create.statement: Rust SDK Plan work does not rely on Cargo artifact dependencies until primary-source evidence has been checked again.

create.name: Recheck stable const string assertions
create.statement: Rust SDK Plan work does not rely on compile-time key assertions until stable Rust support for const string comparison and assertion is verified.

create.name: Capture plan goldens before relocation
create.statement: Rendered-plan goldens are captured before CLI SDK operations move to provenance-store.

create.name: Scan bindings after relocation
create.statement: The workspace-wide Rule binding scan runs after CLI SDK operations move to provenance-store.
